我们应该考虑[GetBuildingGrowing]第二艘£science_ship£科研船了。这可以人我们加快对星系近邻的调查速度。

[GetBuildGrow]舰船；

£dot_green£选择一座恒星基地

We may want to consider [GetBuildingGrowing] a second £science_ship£ Science Ship. This would double the speed at which we can survey our galactic neighborhood!

To [GetBuildGrow] a Ship;

£dot_green£ Select a Starbase
